messages:
incident-bot: page fired: KMS decrypt error rate > 5% in us-west-2 (service=kms, errors=RateLimitExceeded, KeyNotFound). PagerDuty incident PD-7890 created.

raj: acked the PD and joining triage — pulling logs now.

maria: logs show spike at 11:12:20 UTC, lots of 429s to KMS and some 404 "Key not found" for alias `alias/redwood-prod-main-rotate`.

dave: paging HSM vendor and infra. Could be rotation handshake failed during their maintenance window.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by raj; escalated to oncall@redwood-kms.

raj: quick mitigation plan: 1) route decrypts to fallback key alias, 2) pause rotation cron, 3) apply short-term ingress throttling on token endpoints. Will do steps in order.

sre-rotation: we can promote fallback alias if HSM import is possible; need vendor confirm. Any immediate customer impact counts?

customer-success: several customers reported intermittent 500s on inference calls, one dedicated customer opened a support ticket. Asking for list of affected orgs.

raj: impact summary so far: partial decrypt failures for embedding payloads and credential unwraps on us-west-2. Estimated affected requests ~3-6% of traffic starting 11:12 UTC.

maria: command I ran to check aliases: 
```
aws kms list-aliases --region us-west-2 --query "Aliases[?contains(AliasName,'redwood-prod')].AliasName"
```
Return: [`"alias/redwood-prod-fallback"`] — primary alias missing.

dave: vendor confirms they rotated KMS root on their side and the alias import failed due to a handshake timeout. They're re-importing now.

raj: executing traffic shift: adding header `X-Force-Alias: alias/redwood-prod-fallback` at the gateway layer for decrypt endpoints. Applying now.

maria: snippet pushed to nginx conf: 
```
proxy_set_header X-Force-Alias "alias/redwood-prod-fallback";
```
Pushed to canary nodes first.

sre-rotation: promoted fallback alias where allowed; some jobs that require primary key will still 404 until vendor finishes import.

maria: decrypt error rate dropped 6.2% -> 0.4% within 3 minutes after shift. Queued background jobs still see some 404s; replaying.

raj: contacting PD second line for postmortem and handing off monitoring to dave in 20m. Leaving the incident open for verification window. :white_check_mark:

dave: ack. I'll keep watch on metrics and handle vendor communication. If primary alias is restored, we'll reverse traffic shift and re-enable rotation.

oncall-bot: PD note — incident PD-7890 status: mitigated (ack by raj, followup owner: dave).

maria: vendor just confirmed alias import completed and primary alias `alias/redwood-prod-main-rotate` is visible in us-west-2. Running validation checks (small decrypt batch).

sre-rotation: validation run: all decrypts success against primary alias for sample set. Scheduling controlled flip back.

raj: rolling back gateway header and resuming rotation cron with extra logging. Commands used:
```
# remove forced alias header
kubectl -n prod patch configmap gateway-cfg --patch '{"data":{"force_alias":""}}'
# re-enable cron
kubectl -n infra scale deployment rotation-cron --replicas=1
```

maria: post-rollback metrics look clean; error rate stable ~0.1%. No new 404s.

customer-success: compiling list of customers who saw errors, will message top 3 by severity and open a support follow-up.

raj: saved incident notes to runbook: rotation-handshake-failure -> added vendor timeline, mitigation steps, commands used, and followups for postmortem.

dave: handing over monitoring to night oncall (dave) in 12m; will create JIRA for vendor SLA review.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated — customer-facing failures reduced to baseline. Monitoring window 60m before auto-close.

customer-success: thanks team, will update affected customers and share incident summary.

raj: good job everyone. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow. :coffee:
